# Identitycheck

IdentityCheck is a verification solution designed to authenticate user identities with precision and speed, utilizing advanced algorithms and comprehensive data sources to ensure accurate validation, mitigate fraud, and enhance security.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/identitycheck/.

## Actions

- **Check API Health** (read-only): Perform API health check.
- **Delete configuration**: Delete an existing configuration.
- **Delete Notification Endpoint**: Delete a notification endpoint.
- **Fetch All Configurations** (read-only): Fetch all existing configurations.
- **Fetch all notification endpoints** (read-only): Fetch all notification endpoints.
- **Fetch Configuration** (read-only): Fetch a configuration by its code.
- **Fetch Notification Endpoint** (read-only): Fetch a notification endpoint by its code.
- **Fetch Onboardings** (read-only): Retrieve onboardings.
- **Get Document Content** (read-only): Retrieve base64-encoded document content.
- **Retrieve Onboarding Status** (read-only): Retrieve the status of an onboarding.
- **Update Configuration**: Update an existing configuration.
